name: airports_extra
description: Airfields missing from Overture (decommissioned). Naval Air Station Alameda: runways = OSM abandoned runway centrelines (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) buffered to the documented 200 ft and extended to 8,000 / 7,200 ft; taxiways and aprons = pavement traced on the Esri World Imagery orthophoto (2026, viewed only) along the OSM abandoned taxiways and in front of the hangars. Crissy Field (Presidio, Army airfield 1921-74): paved runway pieces traced on the USGS 1:24,000 San Francisco North sheets (1956; 1968 photorevision), each with its own start_year / end_year (data/manual/airports/tools/crissy.py). NAS Alameda pieces cut at the 1946-photo shore (data/manual/airports/tools/nas.py): 1941 inside, 1957 outside (jet-runway additions), all still standing (end 9999).

paved Runway 6/24, east part: the strip on the 1956 sheet (1956 photos); unpaved runway with a paved surface on its south side in a 7/1946 aerial, paved in an 8/1948 aerial -> 1947.5 (ESTIMATED); removed for the Crissy Field restoration (on the 1998 topo, gone in a 2000 aerial) -> 1999 (ESTIMATED)

west extension of Runway 6/24: not on the 1956 sheet, on the 1968 photorevision; 2,900 ft paved on the Apr 1959 chart, 2,610 ft in the 1960 Jeppesen manual -> 1958 (ESTIMATED); removed 1999 (ESTIMATED)
